'''Paul Laudenbahch''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Milford tournament]] on 10 June 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Trooper This Deal]], according to Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d873">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
